draw.en: She likes to draw pictures of her family.

can.en: My little sister can draw a beautiful flower.
can.cn: 我妹妹能画一朵漂亮的花。

picture.en: I have a picture of my dog.
picture.cn: 我有一张我家狗狗的照片。

picture.en: Look at the picture on the wall — it's lovely.

line.en: There is a red line on the paper.
Please stand in a line, boys and girls.

circle.en: The sun looks like a circle.
Please sit in a circle on the floor.
circle.cn: 请大家围成一圈坐在地上。

paint.en: We paint a big picture for our teacher.
paint.cn: 我们给老师画一幅大画。

pen.en: I have a new blue pen.
pen.cn: 我有一支新的蓝色钢笔。

pen.en: Please write your name with this pen.
pen.cn: 请用这支笔写你的名字。

nice.en: Your drawing is really nice, well done!
